_comment: TEE Drive Profiles — open source, community maintained. PRs welcome.

drive_types.label: Fast Drive
drive_types.description: NVMe SSD — fastest available storage. Best for frequently used models.

drive_types.label: Main Drive
drive_types.description: SATA SSD — fast and reliable. Good balance of speed and capacity.

drive_types.label: Large Storage
drive_types.description: Hard Drive — large capacity. Best for storing large models used occasionally.

drive_types.label: USB Drive
drive_types.description: USB Flash Drive — portable storage. Works but slower load times.

drive_types.label: External Drive
drive_types.description: External Drive — portable SSD or HDD. Good for model portability.

drive_types.label: Network Storage
drive_types.description: Network Attached Storage — shared storage. Slower but accessible from multiple machines.

drive_types.label: SD Card
drive_types.description: SD Card — compact portable storage. Slowest option, use only if necessary.

drive_types.label: Speed Cache
drive_types.description: RAM Disk — fastest possible storage. Models load instantly but data is lost on shutdown.

drive_types.label: Storage Drive
drive_types.description: Storage Drive — type could not be determined automatically.

health_states.label: ⚠️  High Temperature
health_states.description: Drive is running hotter than recommended.

health_states.label: ⚠️  Slow Response
health_states.description: Drive is responding slower than expected.

health_states.label: 🚫 Offline
health_states.description: Drive is not responding or has been disconnected.
